# Historical native-only fixture attempt

This immutable archive retains the original 36 source graphs, generator snapshot,
catalogs and reference before explicit arming. Do not run its historical generator
in this directory; use the current parent fixture generator.

The original sources passed the parameter's startup default (drive=0) directly
to stateful objects. That advanced counters and zeroed product accumulators
before the controlled sequence. Six native screens differed because the test
reference assumed a fresh state. These were fixture-initialisation findings,
not six object defects or hardware failures. These sources were never flashed.

The [native attempt receipt](../../../../../evidence/rnbo-event-state-startup-attempt.json)
binds all original source/reference identities and observations. Current sources
block startup defaults until a separate arm action explicitly seeds and starts
the test. All 36 expected output streams and all numerical limits remain
unchanged; no captured output becomes an expectation.
